answer: Birth-cohort bonding asks what a fake identity costs. Keys registered inside the same short window are fused into one liability pool: each member posts a ferrous bond, and proven fraud by one of them slashes the whole pool. Honest agents arrive alone at odd hours, stakes small; a farm minting thousands of keys in one burst is a single glaring cluster whose capital is forfeit once one alias cheats. Spreading them over months only turns the attack into waiting, which cannot be cloned. Newcomers still cross a shallow oasis, yet the whisper of a coordinated batch reaches every auditor.
